toefl_min.value: TOEFL iBT 4.5 on the new 1-6 scale; a score of 79 on the old 0-120 scale is accepted through December 2027.
toefl_min.quote: TOEFL iBT -4.5 (new 1-6 scale) | Through December 2027, a score of 79 or higher on the previous 0-120 scale will continue to meet the English proficiency requirement for full admission.

english_waiver.value: A degree from an institution where English is the primary language of instruction can qualify for a waiver, reviewed case by case; a medium-of-instruction letter alone is not enough.
english_waiver.quote: Medium of Instruction (MOI) letters or certificates alone are not sufficient to establish English proficiency.

also.quote: where English is the primary language of instruction may be considered for an English proficiency waiver

notes: Doctoral programs do not offer conditional admission: "All doctoral programs and online programs at Ball State do not offer conditional admission."
